task.title: Publish VSCode Extension to GitHub Packages
task.description: Enable installing the VSCode extension from any repo with: npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode
task.problem: Users cannot easily install the Claude Kanban VSCode extension from any repository. Currently there is no npx-based distribution mechanism for the VSCode extension like there is for the kanban CLI package. Users must manually download and install the .vsix file.
task.value: Enables quick, single-command installation of the VSCode extension from any repository using npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode. Matches the existing distribution pattern for the kanban CLI package, providing a consistent installation experience across all Claude Kanban tools.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a user has npm/npx available And they have access to the GitHub Packages registry When they run npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode Then the installer finds the .vsix file in the package And runs code --install-extension to install it And shows ANSI-colored output following kanban patterns And displays next steps after successful installation
Given a user runs npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode --help Then they see usage information and available flags
Given a user runs npx @mattfletcher94/claudeban-vscode --version Then they see the package version number
Given the code CLI is not available or fails When the user runs the installer Then the error from the code command is shown naturally
